The '''BlasTech 4''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon designed by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] and used for personal protection in the [[Time/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] owned twin BlasTech 4s that he carried in hip [[Holster/Legends|holsters]], though he sometimes replaced them with an [[E-3 blaster]] worn in an [[Limb/Legends|ankle]] holster. While he was on [[Zeerid Korr's farm|his farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with Leneer's arrival on Dantooine, occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> a [[BT-7 Thunderclap|BT7 Thunderstrike]] arrived at the [[Farm/Legends|farm]]. Korr thought that it was the criminal organization, the [[Exchange]], coming to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him for not completing obligations he had to them. He was carrying his E-3 blaster at the time, but wished that he was carrying his twin BlasTech 4s. However, it was in fact his friend and former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The BlasTech 4 was mentioned in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />
